title: Delivery of OXCART aircraft to Area 51 by road (p. 287)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a large crated load on a truck traveling along a curving road through hilly terrain. The caption reads "Delivery of OXCART aircraft to Area 51." Text below describes a 1962 CIA reorganization moving the OXCART and U-2 programs to the new Directorate of Research and later the Directorate of Science and Technology.
